apps.localizedDescription: Madeira Nightly runs Windows PC games on compatible iPhones using FEX-Emu, Wine, and Metal. This unofficial listing follows camhoc/Madeira releases. Requires JIT; follow the project instructions for device compatibility and setup.

versions.localizedDescription:
**Install with FlekStore:** https://flekstore.com/madeira

**Battle.net setup guide:** see the attached "Battle.net setup guide.md"

---

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.29**
Battle.net + everything since 0.2.26
**New**
• **Battle.net runs, and StarCraft: Remastered starts from it (setup in the PDF)**
• **.NET 10** in Settings › Runtimes
• **Self-restart loops** (Fallout: NV) are stopped
• **Low-memory message** when iOS gives less memory
**Games**
• **Cyberpunk 2077** starts (D3D12 fix)
• **AC Mirage** passes its Developer Mode check
• **Detroit: Become Human** gets Vulkan
• **Sonic Generations** finds your controller
• **Rust** and **Assetto Corsa** skip their launchers
• **Steep** (Epic) waits for Ubisoft Connect
• **Project DIVA MM+** fits in memory
• **Slay the Spire 2** gets more room to load
• **Black Ops III** sees the real CPU cores
• **Denshattack!** keeps its full memory pool
• **Hades II**, **L.A. Noire**, **The Forest**, **Just Cause 2**: new recommended settings
• **Witcher 3** AVX settings removed
**Fixes**
• **Battle.net** no longer fills the memory pool
• **Move to drive** no longer fails on a good copy
• **Get Help** reports explain the config they show
**Battle.net notes**
• **First start** can stop at the logo: start again
• **Error 2123** + repair on start: let it finish
• **Keep Madeira in front** while it's open
• **Overwatch 2** doesn't start yet, please don't report it
**Logging**
• More detail for **Steam code 42**, **crashes**, **lost mouse input** and **drive libraries**
Send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks 🙏


---

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Madeira uses the local network to pair with this device for JIT, without a computer, and to download Steam games from a PC on this network.
